items.title: Random POTD Pero Antic. Macedonian PF went pro in 99 & had a nice career abroad til signing w/ATL in 13. Spent 2 yrs in ATL as cult hero backup (6 ppg, 3.5 rpg in 17 mpg). Returned to Europe from 15-18 before retiring. Now an exec in Europe. Had (and has) a pretty memorable look.

items.title: Paige Bueckers on how she would describe her game:
items.body_excerpt:
Paige Bueckers on how she would describe her game:

"I would say passion, joy...when people watch me play I want them to feel like a sense from me of gratitude to be out there and just a love for the game. I love this game so much so I want that to shine through when I'm playing"

items.title: Fever beat the Fire 112-98 for a season-best 5-game win streak.
items.body_excerpt:
Fever beat the Fire 112-98 for a season-best 5-game win streak.

- Scored 100+ pts in all five (13x this season)
- Clark responds with triple-double: 26-10-10 (SH rebounds too)
- Mitchell (26) with 20+ pts for the 13th straight game
- Timpson 15pts in 19mins
